business_problem: Centria needed to expand shared services into product-oriented parts of Grupo Breca, which required stronger logistics, inventory and plant-support capabilities than its existing systems could provide.
solution_summary: Centria worked with IBM Services to deploy SAP S/4HANA and modernize the shared-services platform it uses for Grupo Breca companies. The organization had historically focused on service-based subsidiaries, but expansion into agriculture, fishing and manufacturing required better support for logistics, inventory, plant maintenance and materials management. IBM Services implemented SAP S/4HANA to harmonize processes and provide a common data core, while the SAP landscape was hosted by IBM Services in an IBM data center and migrated onto IBM Power systems virtualized with IBM PowerVM. SAP HANA compression and SAP Fiori apps further improved accessibility and storage efficiency. Together, those components created a more scalable ERP environment where operational data could be entered once, reported instantly and reused across multiple lines of business, giving Centria a platform to sell broader shared services inside the group.

data_flow: Business data from shared-service processes enters SAP S/4HANA, is stored in SAP HANA on IBM Power infrastructure virtualized by IBM PowerVM, and is then exposed through SAP Fiori apps and reports for managers across Grupo Breca subsidiaries.
business_outcome: Centria reduced process time, improved reporting speed and storage efficiency, and built a broader shared-services platform it could extend into new industries within the conglomerate.
